test_name: oauth:provisionOrganization — the master secret passed as callerToken leaves no digest of itself in oauth_audit_log
identity: no Clerk identity; master secret as callerToken
evidence: AssertionError: actorTokenHash equals unsalted sha256 of the master secret: expected true to be false
note: Positive control in test: call succeeded, exactly one organization_provision row with 64-hex actorTokenHash.

test_name: oauth:createAuthorizationCode — the single-use code is not stored in plaintext
evidence: AssertionError: row.code holds the plaintext code: expected true to be false
note: Purge half not tested: grep shows no code path touching oauth_authorization_codes outside oauth.ts/schema.ts, and the schema comment's processExpiredOauthCodes cron does not exist (grep -rn processExpiredOauthCodes convex -> only the schema comment).

test_name: oauth:getRefreshTokenByHash — a refresh token presented once is refused on replay (invalid_grant)
identity: confidential OAuth client with client secret, MCP server's service-account client faked in memory
evidence: AssertionError: replay status (error=undefined): expected 200 to be 400
note: Driven through the real /token handler (app.request) with an in-memory Convex fake that mirrors getRefreshTokenByHash and accepts any refresh consume/revoke mutation; first use returns 200 (positive control). Family-revocation half not tested.

test_name: oauth:patchScopeProfileEmergency — renaming master (wildcard prefixes) to a non-master id is refused by D4 AND oauth:patchScopeProfileEmergency — a rename onto an existing profileId is refused (no duplicate profileId)
evidence: AssertionError: promise resolved "{ ...(4) }" instead of rejecting (both cases: master->client-x, client-generic->public-readonly)
note: Two cases, both RED. getScopeProfile .unique() throw on the duplicate not exercised separately.

test_name: iframeEmbedSessions:createSession — a member of org B cannot re-use org A's sessionId, and org A keeps read/revoke on its own session
identity: org A member and org B member (Clerk organizationId claim), neither the service account
evidence: AssertionError: org B's second insert of sessionId S1: promise resolved instead of rejecting
note: Second test (userId from verified identity) also RED: expected 'someone-else' to be 'user-org-a'.

test_name: http:POST /issueBearerFromClerk — an unauthenticated failure does not echo the expected audience or issuer AND — minting a second bearer leaves at most one live bearer for the user
identity: verified Clerk user (RS256 JWT signed by a test key, JWKS fetch stubbed), allowed extId declared in body; driven via t.fetch
evidence: AssertionError: 401 body contains the expected audience: expected true to be false; AssertionError: live bearers after two mints: expected 2 to be less than or equal to 1
note: Both RED, each after a positive control (401 reached; two mints return 200). The extId-is-caller-declared gate itself is not behaviourally testable from outside (a curl client and the extension send the same bytes); not asserted.

test_name: http:POST /api/eta/verify-publish-token — a REVISE note plus a one-character expectedSha is not a valid publish approval (+2 more cases: refusal does not echo client note; client-org task not resolved)
identity: fleet master bearer (BEARER_SECRET_MASTER) in Authorization header; driven via t.fetch
evidence: AssertionError: valid for a REVISE note matched by 1 char: expected true to be false; response body contains acme's note text; valid:true for a task of org acme
